column1: # The balance's damage by gun and ammo (stage 1b): NTM's damage of a shot times mult; neg is added to the ammo's
# armour threshold negation, pen to its armour piercing. One line a pair; ammo * is the gun's own line: mult for all
# its ammo (over the pairs) and its receiver's changes (delay = ticks after a shot, auto, mag = rounds, dmg = base
# damage). An ammo of a gun not here: the gun's pair of the same family, else NTM's (BalanceGunsRule). A file of the
# same name in config/ (ntm-gunfeel-balance-guns.tsv) is read instead of this one. Source: gun-multipliers-v4.md.
